title: If They Say You're Overreacting, Watch This

scenes.caption: You saw the flirty text. You heard the lie. And when you brought it up, they looked at you and said, "You're overreacting."
scenes.caption_roman: You saw the flirty text. You heard the lie. And when you brought it up, they looked at you and said, "You're overreacting."

scenes.caption: In that moment two things happen. You start doubting yourself, and they walk away unchallenged. That's the point.
scenes.caption_roman: In that moment two things happen. You start doubting yourself, and they walk away unchallenged. That's the point.

scenes.caption: This is gaslighting: making you distrust your own memory and perception so that only their version of reality counts.
scenes.caption_roman: This is gaslighting: making you distrust your own memory and perception so that only their version of reality counts.

scenes.caption: A person who cares about you asks, "Why do you feel that way?" A controller tells you how you're allowed to feel.
scenes.caption_roman: A person who cares about you asks, "Why do you feel that way?" A controller tells you how you're allowed to feel.

scenes.caption: Notice the pattern. It's never the issue. It's always your tone, your memory, your reaction. The target keeps moving.
scenes.caption_roman: Notice the pattern. It's never the issue. It's always your tone, your memory, your reaction. The target keeps moving.

scenes.caption: Your feelings are evidence about you, not proof you're crazy. Repeated denial of what you saw is a documented tactic.
scenes.caption_roman: Your feelings are evidence about you, not proof you're crazy. Repeated denial of what you saw is a documented tactic.

scenes.caption: Try one line: "I'm not asking if I'm overreacting. I'm telling you how this affected me." Then watch what they do. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.
scenes.caption_roman: Try one line: "I'm not asking if I'm overreacting. I'm telling you how this affected me." Then watch what they do. Follow Coercion Files for the psychology they don't teach you in school.

description:
If They Say You're Overreacting, Watch This. "You're overreacting" is a trap.
Coercive Control Awareness: how coercion really works, why it works on you, and exactly how to protect yourself.

• A sentence that ends the game
